note: 平地近似；建筑高度为 3D-GloBFP 模型估算（该区最高仅 117m，超高层被低估，地标待补）；海面由 OSM 海岸线按方向闭合、内陆水面取 OSM natural=water，只渲染不碰撞；道路宽度为推定值。

provenance.note: Extruded massing only. Building heights are 3D-GloBFP model estimates (grid 2265, figshare article 28904453 linked from Zenodo 15487037, MD5 90588c1dab8e88cccedd98464155d41c); the pilot maximum is about 117m, so high-rises are underestimated and landmarks are not yet added. Surface roads use inferred widths including trunk/motorway links; bridges and tunnels are dropped; no terrain. Sea is closed from OSM coastline orientation and inland water from OSM natural=water; water is render-only. Street furniture is procedural. Combined derived data retains ODbL obligations.
